$comment: Which sprite each hand-authored ingredient wears. Chosen by scripts/art-match.js on essence proximity, not by name, because the UI tints and labels everything by dominant essence and art that disagrees with its own vector teaches the wrong thing at a glance. Ingredients with no honest match are absent on purpose and keep their essence badge. NOTE: once a file has been renamed onto its ingredient id the matcher can only ever re-pick it, so re-running --write on a fully adopted folder proposes churn rather than improvement. Edit this map by hand from here on.

$previous.$comment: The by-name picks this replaced, so the renames can be undone.
